changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT li.id AS intent_id, li.job_name, li.arrival_id, li.stage, p.attempt, li.attempt AS current_attempt, (p.attempt = li.attempt) AS is_current_attempt, count(so.id) AS observation_count, count(DISTINCT so.outcome) AS distinct_outcome_count, (CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT so.outcome) = 1 THEN max(so.outcome) ELSE NULL END)::STRING AS observed_outcome, max(so.observed_at) AS latest_observed_at, (CASE WHEN p.attempt <> li.attempt THEN 'STALE_ATTEMPT' WHEN count(so.id) = 0 THEN 'UNOBSERVED' WHEN count(DISTINCT so.outcome) > 1 THEN 'CONFLICTING' ELSE 'CONSISTENT' END)::STRING AS attempt_evidence_state FROM public.launch_intent li JOIN (SELECT id AS intent_id, attempt FROM public.launch_intent UNION SELECT intent_id, attempt FROM public.stage_outcome) p ON p.intent_id = li.id LEFT JOIN public.stage_outcome so ON so.intent_id = li.id AND so.attempt = p.attempt GROUP BY li.id, li.job_name, li.arrival_id, li.stage, li.attempt, p.attempt ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'LAUNCHED_NO_OUTCOME'::STRING AS wedge_class, fa.client_token::STRING AS client, li.arrival_id, li.job_name::STRING AS job_name, li.stage::STRING AS route, li.job_name::STRING AS subject, li.created_at AS stuck_since, (extract(epoch FROM (now() - li.created_at)) / 3600.0)::DECIMAL(12,2) AS age_hours, ('attempt=' || li.attempt::STRING || ' launched, no outcome recorded')::STRING AS detail, 'launch_intent'::STRING AS source_table FROM public.launch_intent li LEFT JOIN public.file_arrival fa ON fa.id = li.arrival_id LEFT JOIN public.stage_outcome so ON so.intent_id = li.id AND so.attempt = li.attempt WHERE so.id IS NULL AND li.status = 'LAUNCHED' AND li.created_at < now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'ATTEMPT_NEAR_EXHAUSTION'::STRING, fa.client_token::STRING, li.arrival_id, li.job_name::STRING, li.stage::STRING, li.job_name::STRING, li.created_at, (extract(epoch FROM (now() - li.created_at)) / 3600.0)::DECIMAL(12,2), ('attempt=' || li.attempt::STRING || ' at/over warning threshold 3')::STRING, 'launch_intent'::STRING FROM public.launch_intent li LEFT JOIN public.file_arrival fa ON fa.id = li.arrival_id WHERE li.attempt >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'ARRIVAL_UNCLAIMED'::STRING, fa.client_token::STRING, fa.id, NULL::STRING, fa.route_id::STRING, fa.physical_filename::STRING, fa.arrived_at, (extract(epoch FROM (now() - fa.arrived_at)) / 3600.0)::DECIMAL(12,2), ('status=' || fa.status || ' with no launch_intent')::STRING, 'file_arrival'::STRING FROM public.file_arrival fa LEFT JOIN public.launch_intent li ON li.arrival_id = fa.id WHERE li.id IS NULL AND fa.status <> 'QUARANTINED' AND fa.arrived_at < now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root') ORDER BY stuck_since

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT fa.client_token::STRING AS client, fa.arrived_at::DATE AS process_date, count(DISTINCT fa.id) AS files_in, count(DISTINCT fa.id) FILTER (WHERE fa.status = 'QUARANTINED') AS quarantined, count(DISTINCT li.id) AS launched, count(DISTINCT so.id) AS outcomes FROM public.file_arrival fa LEFT JOIN public.launch_intent li ON li.arrival_id = fa.id LEFT JOIN public.stage_outcome so ON so.intent_id = li.id GROUP BY fa.client_token, fa.arrived_at::DATE ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')
